# FollowThru

> FollowThru is a daily accountability coach app for side projects, on iPhone and Android. Each day you pick one small "Move" (15, 30 or 60 minutes) for the thing you're building, and Momo, a friendly sloth coach, helps you do it: he breaks the Move into short steps with a timer, drafts writing with you, checks in each evening and remembers your project. Every Sunday you get a Weekly Builder Report. It is currently a free beta.

FollowThru is for people building something on the side of a job, school or family: creators growing an audience, indie app makers, small online store owners, and people starting something new after a layoff. It is not a habit tracker or a to-do list: it focuses on one meaningful step a day for one project, and it never uses streak pressure or guilt. A missed day is just a fresh start; "momentum" grows with each Move and forgives a bad day.

Key facts:
- App store name: FollowThru: The Hustle Coach.
- Platforms: iPhone (via Apple TestFlight during the beta) and Android (via Google Play testing).
- Try it on iPhone now (public TestFlight invite): https://testflight.apple.com/join/3aSdxBz7
- Android: join the beta list at https://usefollowthru.com/#join to get an invite by email.
- Price: free during the beta. A free plan and an optional Pro plan come at public launch.
- Privacy: no ads, data never sold, Momo's AI is never trained on your data, and you can delete everything from inside the app.
- Website: https://usefollowthru.com  ·  Support: support@usefollowthru.com
